description.html: This 70x27x30 cm glass terrarium with a volume of 56.7 liters is made from glass of the right thickness for its size. The outer sides are covered with decorative film you choose when ordering: wood, bamboo, marble, black or white.

The horizontal layout with 70 cm of length gives a floor area where a basking zone, a cool zone and a hiding area are easy to arrange. Reptile thermoregulation depends on being able to move between warm and cool zones inside the terrarium. The ventilation system is designed for constant airflow that prevents overheating and trapped moisture.

We offer full customization: you choose the film, background and ventilation, plus optional LED lighting or a thermostat. If this model doesn't fit your space, we build terrariums in any dimensions. Call for a quote.
